title: HomeCart
tagline: Android home-shopping client; MyBasket and MyPurchases live as sibling repos.
overview: HomeCart is the lead Android shopping client in a 2026 Codeberg cluster (HOMECART, MyBasket, MyPurchases). Those siblings are called out here instead of three near-duplicate case studies.
problem: Household shopping lists and carts needed a native Android client, and splitting every screen into its own 'product' would lie to visitors.
solution: HomeCart as the product entry; MyBasket and MyPurchases as named companion repos.
architecture: Java Android apps on Codeberg. HomeCart is the gallery cover; the others share the same week of work.
challenges: Deciding which repo is the product vs a screen
lessonsLearned: Group by user job, not by repository birthday
futureImprovements: Deep links between the three apps if they stay separate APKs
results: One shopping product with two named companion repos instead of three thin case studies
